relations.rationale: Zeno's warm-up stretching and Alma's post-race chatting are unrelated events with no bearing on each other.
The course layout has no bearing on the relative finishing order of Vik and Pia.
The course winding through villages is unrelated to whether the final descent was trickier than expected.
Spectators lining the road is unrelated to a bike reach comparison between Tess and Pia.
Spectators lining the roads during the race is unrelated to Alma's post-race behavior.
Pia finishing ahead of Zeno has no bearing on when Alma arrived that morning.
Pia finishing ahead of Zeno doesn't determine the relative finish of Zeno and Vik.
Pia beating Zeno doesn't directly determine whether Vik finished ahead of Pia.
Pia finishing ahead of Zeno supports the idea that riders would later gather to discuss race results, since a race occurred.
Alma arriving earliest of everyone supports the claim that she arrived long before sunrise, as both indicate she arrived very early.
Alma's early arrival time has no bearing on the finishing order of Zeno and Vik.
Alma arriving earliest that morning is unrelated to her staying late after the race chatting with volunteers.
Alma's early arrival at this event has no bearing on whether another regional event is already scheduled.
Alma's early arrival time is unrelated to the comparative ages of Vik and Alma.
Alma's arrival time before sunrise has no bearing on Zeno nodding in agreement.
Vik being younger than Tess doesn't determine his age relative to Alma.
Vik being younger than Tess is unrelated to how rigorously he trains compared to Tess and Alma.
Vik being younger than Alma is unrelated to his training rigor compared to Tess and Alma.
Vik's age relative to Alma has no bearing on his finishing position relative to Pia.
Vik's training rigor is unrelated to Zeno nodding in agreement about something else.
